title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, and supply constraints, optionally coupled to infectious disease transmission.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe and are influenced by contacts' mask use and perceived norms over their social network, updating attitudes and decisions.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Policies and mandates affect individuals' compliance decisions; enforcement at workplaces and public places can restrict access or impose penalties.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Information campaigns and media messages modify risk perception, attitudes, and trust, influencing adoption decisions.

interactions.name: mask_market_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks subject to availability, price, and quality; shortages and prices influence adoption.

interactions.name: location_based_access_control
interactions.description: Entry to locations may require masks; non-compliant individuals may be denied entry or sanctioned.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_optional
interactions.description: If enabled, contacts can transmit infection; masks reduce transmission probabilities (source control and wearer protection).

interactions.name: household_norms_spillover
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's attitudes and mask availability, affecting adoption in external contexts.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks in public at each time step.

metrics.name: workplace_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of agents wearing masks in workplaces/schools over time.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days elapsed until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum fraction of mask use achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_end
metrics.description: Adoption rate during the final 7 days, averaged.

metrics.name: mandate_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of agents complying with mask mandates when active.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_SES
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rate between highest and lowest socioeconomic quintiles.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Reduction in cumulative infections relative to a no-mask baseline (if disease enabled).

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated Rt over time, accounting for mask use and contact patterns (if disease enabled).

metrics.name: average_mask_quality_in_use
metrics.description: Weighted average quality of masks used across interactions.
